errors.error_description: The case statement computing next_q omits an assignment for the 2'b11 branch and lacks a default assignment, inferring a latch during synthesis.
Declared an identifier using an escaped SystemVerilog keyword as a name (logic \always_comb;), which misuses a reserved word as an identifier.
The module recursively instantiates itself (u_child), creating an illegal hierarchical recursion at the module boundary.
